description: This is an abstract PHP class 'BaseWriter' belonging to the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for handling the core functionalities of writing spreadsheet data, such as managing chart inclusion, formula recalculation, disk caching, and file handle operations.

classes.name: BaseWriter
classes.description: An abstract class that provides foundational functionalities for spreadsheet writers, including configuration options and file handling methods.

methods.name: getIncludeCharts
methods.description: Returns whether charts should be included when writing the spreadsheet.

methods.name: setIncludeCharts
methods.description: Sets whether charts should be included in the output.

methods.name: getPreCalculateFormulas
methods.description: Returns the current setting for pre-calculating formulas.

methods.name: setPreCalculateFormulas
methods.description: Sets whether to pre-calculate formulas upon saving.

methods.name: getUseDiskCaching
methods.description: Returns whether disk caching is enabled.

methods.name: setUseDiskCaching
methods.description: Enables or disables disk caching, optionally setting the cache directory.

methods.name: getDiskCachingDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory used for disk caching.

methods.name: openFileHandle
methods.description: Opens a file handle for writing, accepting a filename or resource.

methods.name: maybeCloseFileHandle
methods.description: Closes the file handle if it was opened by this class.

methods.name: processFlags
methods.description: Processes flag bits to set options like chart inclusion and formula pre-calculation.
